answer: Make every identity leave a public audit trail along a shared ridge: each action is timestamped and signed, and random peers re-check a slice of the trail every epoch. A saffron dye marks any trail whose timestamps move in perfect lockstep with another — the fingerprint of one operator behind many faces. Hollow identities with no real work behind their signatures are pruned, so a sybil farmer must forge a distinct, busy trail per clone at full labor cost, while one honest agent simply walks its own ridge.
